> Yes.
>
> >Can I take back my card after the combat ?
>
> No.

Um, to elaborate something which may not be clear about the previous answer:
you do not pick the same, discarded card back up from the discard pile, no.
Your hand size does return to normal after combat, therefore you draw a card
from your library to fill it up.

Fred
